desktop.sync_warning: External storage not in sync ({code}). Open the Storage tab.
desktop.err_different_owners: These vaults belong to different owners and cannot be merged.
desktop.err_local_corrupt: The local vault file is corrupt (not valid JSON); it was left untouched.
desktop.err_local_invalid: The local vault file is not a valid vault; it was left untouched.
desktop.err_no_vault_file: No vault file found. Create a new vault instead.
desktop.storage_err_NOT_CONFIGURED: No sync location set. Enter the full path to your vault file on the Storage screen.
desktop.storage_err_NOT_FOUND: Vault file not found at the configured path. Has the file been moved?
desktop.storage_err_DRIVE_MISSING: External drive not found. Plug in your drive and try again.
desktop.storage_err_PERMISSION_DENIED: Cannot read vault file — check folder permissions.
desktop.storage_err_CORRUPT: The file at the sync path does not appear to be a valid vault.
desktop.storage_err_DRIVE_FULL: The storage location is full. Free up space and try again.
desktop.storage_err_IO: Could not access the storage location.
desktop.storage_err_CONFLICT: The storage copy has changes this device does not have (newer or diverged). It was left untouched; use "Use local copy" on the Storage screen to overwrite it.
desktop.storage_err_OWNER_MISMATCH: The file at the sync path belongs to a different vault. It was left untouched.
desktop.storage_err_changed: The storage copy changed since it was read. Run "Test read" again before resolving.
desktop.unlock_vaults_found_one: One vault found — click it to unlock
desktop.unlock_vaults_found_other: {n} vaults found — choose one to unlock
desktop.unlock_write_phrase: Write down your recovery phrase — it will not be shown again:
desktop.unlock_written_continue: I have written it down — Continue
desktop.alert_adopt_failed: Unlocked from storage copy, but could not update the local file: {detail}
desktop.claims_empty: No claims yet. Add one to get started.
desktop.merge_subtitle: Enter the passphrase of the vault you want to import. Claims that already exist are skipped.
desktop.merge_no_others: No other vault files found in the vault directory.
desktop.merge_warning: The source vault file will be permanently deleted after a successful import.
desktop.storage_hint: Keep an encrypted copy of this vault in a folder synced by iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, or on a flash drive. The file is always encrypted; the provider never sees your data. Enter the full path to the vault file, e.g. {example}.
desktop.storage_up_to_date: Storage copy is up to date (sequence {seq}).
desktop.storage_diverged: Storage copy and local copy have diverged (both have changes the other lacks). Neither will be overwritten automatically. Resolve it below.
desktop.storage_remote_newer: Storage copy is newer (sequence {remote} vs local {local}). It will be used next time you unlock.
desktop.storage_local_newer: Local copy is newer (sequence {local} vs storage {remote}). It will be written to storage on the next save.
desktop.storage_confirm_unverified: The file at the storage path could not be verified as a vault ({detail}). Overwrite it with the local copy? This cannot be undone.
desktop.storage_why_different: The storage file belongs to a DIFFERENT vault.
desktop.storage_why_newer: The storage copy is newer than or has diverged from the local copy.
desktop.storage_confirm_overwrite: {why} Overwrite it with the local copy? This cannot be undone.
desktop.storage_merged_saved: Merged and saved to both the local copy and storage.
desktop.storage_confirm_keep_local: Keep local and discard the storage copy? Changes only in the storage copy will be lost. This cannot be undone.
desktop.storage_confirm_keep_external: Keep external and discard the local copy? Changes only in the local copy will be lost. This cannot be undone.
desktop.storage_kept_external: Kept storage copy; local copy replaced.
desktop.storage_both_modified: Both copies were modified since your last sync.
desktop.storage_sequences: Local is at sequence {local}, storage at {remote}.
desktop.storage_enter_passphrase: Enter your passphrase to preview the merge.
